title: Official ACCA Past Exam Papers (Dip IFR)
description: The authentic past question papers and official suggested solutions, published directly by ACCA. Always the definitive source — use this platform's own question bank alongside it, not instead of it.

title: DipIFR Mock Exam & Debrief Videos
description: ACCA's own pre-sitting mock exam (via Learn360) plus examiner debrief videos, including an Arabic-language debrief.

title: CBE Specimen Exam (Official Demo)
description: ACCA's own computer-based exam demo — the real word processor and spreadsheet response tools you'll use on exam day. Try this once you're comfortable in this platform's CBE workspace.

title: DipIFR Study Resources Hub
description: ACCA's full index of official DipIFR resources: syllabus, examinable documents, technical articles, and examiner approach articles.

title: Technical Articles & Topic Explainers
description: ACCA's full index of examiner's-approach articles, topic explainers, and short technical guides (e.g. goodwill impairment, revaluation of non-current assets), including video walkthroughs.

title: DipIFR Exam Dates & Timetables
description: Official sitting dates. DipIFR runs twice a year, in June and December.
